description: This file contains functional tests for the AccountController's sign-in and account management features in a web application, using Xunit for testing and HttpClient for HTTP requests.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A class providing functional UI tests for the login and account management features, such as sign-in, token extraction, and profile update.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the login URL returns a successful response containing a specific email address.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Tests that the regex correctly matches the request verification token in HTML input string.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Tests that the login page contains a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates posting valid credentials and verifies that the login redirects to the root URL.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Logs in, navigates to the profile page, updates the phone number, and verifies the change appears.
